CEDRO V: Innovation, Entrepreneurship and Research: - Energy Hub to be online in Q2 2022; - Selection of 5 start-ups for the acceleration phase in Q1 2022 - Completion of Acceleration phase in Q3 2022 - Launch the energy audit RFQ for the selected sites;
Technology Transfer: - Implementation of at least 2 additional Solar PV technologies - Implementation of 3 energy efficiency sites - Implementation of 1 concentrated solar thermal site - Implementation of at least 12 more SEACAP sites
ARZ Certification: - Launch the Betta Version of ARZ Building Rating System
REC Establishment: - Legal assistance provided for regulatory framework provision for RECs. - Sign the Issuer agreement with LCEC in Q1 2022 - I-RE to host a workshop on RECs in Lebanon - I-REC to draft a guideline report for the entire REC process in Q3 2022
Policy and communication: - Launch the Energy Espresso Podcast online in Q1 2022
CEDRO V (COVID): Activity 1.2 Providing medical waste equipment - Provision of the needed boxes for sharp medical disposal 7 governmental hospitals Number of boxes being procured: 145 - Potential new activity: provision of additional bins for medical waste segregation
Activity 1.3. Implementing solar for health initiatives 1- Implementation of the solar PV systems for the selected 10 public hospitals with a possible expansion to 5 additional hospitals in case of budget availability 2- Implementation of solar hot water systems for the selected 10 public hospitals (to maintain/upgrade and install new systems) 3- Implementation of Lighting retrofit for the selected 10 public hospitals 4- Establishment of the Energy Strategy for the Lebanese Health Care Sector together with recommendations for new buildings designs 5- Implementation of a Computerized Maintenance Management System for 10 public hospitals 6- Implementation of Building Management Systems for 10 hospitals, 7. Implementation of Variable Frequency Drives, Air Curtains on Entrances, Vinyl Curtains, Chilled Water System Optimization, Variable Refrigerant Flow Systems, Steam and Heating Network System Improvements and Water Conservation Measures for 10 hospitals

Innovation, Entrepreneurship and Research: - RFP for Energy Hub was finalized in Q1 and launched in Q2; - Bidders for the Energy Hub were evaluated in Q2, and the contract was awaraded in Q3. Deliverables 1,2,3 were done by the contractor - Deliverables 1 & 2 were submitted - 21 start-ups out of 58 submissions were chosen to proceed in the first phase of incubation
Implementation of RE/EE applications: - Application Form was edited and relaunched in Q1, then edited in Q3 to become an open application - Total of 37 applications were received since the first launch of application - More than 50 assessment calls and site visits were conducted to industries - 2 main events were hosted in Q2 to present the CEDRO 5 Activity 2 project for industries (fFirst for Metn indstrialists and the second for Bekaa industrialists) where a total of 26 industries attended - Letter of Intent drafted and signed with 6 industries: Solar PV: Elcir, Rokyplast, Emile Rassam Solar Thermal: Beesline Energy Efficiency: Gemayel Freres, Pharmaline - Solar Thermal, Solar PV, and Energy Audit RFQs for Beesline were prepared and launched online in Q2, evaluated in Q3, and awarded in Q4 - Solar PV RFQ for Elcir was launched and evaluated in Q4, & solar PV ITB for Rokyplast was launched in Q4 - 4 applications are currently under detailed assessment in Q4 - 2 main events were hosted in Q2 to present the CEDRO 5 Activity 2 for industries (fFirst for Metn indstrialists and the second for Bekaa industrialists) where a total of 26 industries attended.
Implementation of SEACAPS/SEEAP: - 14 sites have been completed (Full grant) - 1 school has been selected for crowdfunding. All Materials for the campaign including showcase video have been prepared and launched through crowdfunding and funds were mobilised - 16 sites were assessed in Q4 to be tendered in Q1 of 2022
ARZ Certification: - The alfa version of the portal for the online ARZ rating was developped in Q2 - 1 workshop on train the trainers for ARZ full certification was implemented in Q2 - The Betta version developped in Q3 and Q4, to be launched in Q1 of 2022
REC Establishment: - A webinar was hosted in Q1 by I-REC and CEDRO focusing on Facilitating reliable renewable energy procurement in Lebanon; introducing energy attribute certificate schemes - MoEW nominated LCEC as a focal point on this activity after sending a letter from CEDRO to MoEW introducing this activity and asking them to nominate a focal point, and a meeting was done to introduce the IREC to LCEC and the way forward was discussed
Policy and communication: - CEDRO 5 website went online in Q4
